subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter — audit period clarification
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <audits@acmepayments.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmepayments.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit period clarification

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well — I’m coordinating Acme Payments’ vendor assurance intake for payments tooling and we need to obtain a recent SOC 2 Type II report for Redwood Inference. Can you please confirm whether a Type II report exists and, if so, the audit period covered (we typically require disclosure of the start/end dates for coverage).

In addition to the report, please provide either a bridge letter (if the Type II coverage doesn’t extend to our required window) or confirmation that the report covers the period Jan 1, 2024 — Dec 31, 2024. We’ll also need a short control summary for the following points:
- KMS/Key rotation practices (who manages keys, HSM/KMS vendor)
- Retention and access logs (retention duration, log storage location)
- Incident response and breach notification SLA
- Data segregation for dedicated and hosted customers

Preferred secure transfer options: presigned S3 link, SFTP, or a shared folder (Google Drive link is OK if you manage permissions). If you have a standard procurement intake form, please attach.

We aim to close this by Jun 25 — please let me know if that timeline works.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Vendor Assurance Lead
Acme Payments
[Attachment: Acme_Request_Form.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <audits@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit period clarification

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answer: yes, Redwood Inference has a SOC 2 Type II report. Below are the immediate items and transfer options; I’ve attached a compact summary to accelerate your intake.

What we can provide now (and typical turnaround):
- SOC 2 Type II report (current coverage: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31) — full PDF of auditor report
- Bridge letter options (we can issue a dated bridge letter that extends observable controls to the present day; typical turnaround 2 business days)
- Control snapshot summarizing KMS, log retention, IR runbooks, and data separation (attached)

Secure transfer options (pick one):
1) Google Drive shared folder (we’ll add named recipients; link + ACL) — quickest for downloads
2) Presigned S3 link (3-day expiry) — suitable for larger bundles
3) Managed SFTP endpoint (we can provision temporary creds)

Attached: redwood_soc2_summary_2024.pdf (compact control summary) and bridge_letter_options.pdf (templated wordings we can sign). If you prefer, I can also provide the full auditor PDF via presigned link — tell me which method you want and I’ll start the transfer.

Suggested minimal share set we recommend for procurement review:
- Full SOC 2 Type II PDF (auditor-signed)
- Bridge letter (if audit window pre-dates your required window)
- Short KMS & logging PR FAQ (1 page)
- Evidence manifest (list of artifacts we’ll include if requested)

If you need any redaction (e.g., customer names), indicate which sections and we’ll coordinate with the auditor/legal. Jun 25 is fine; if you confirm Drive or S3 we’ll aim to complete by Jun 20.

One-line templates (if helpful):
- For procurement: “Confirmed: SOC 2 Type II (2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31). Full report available via secure link; bridge letter available on request.”
- For engineering contacts: “Planned deliverables: SOC2 PDF, bridge letter, 1-page KMS & logs summary, evidence manifest.”

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary_2024.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: bridge_letter_options.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit period clarification

Ben — forwarding the request from Acme Payments. They asked for a Drive share of the Type II PDF and bridge letter; timeline is tight (wants to close by Jun 25). I attached our compact summary and the bridge letter templates.

Quick asks for you / security ops:
- Confirm the exact PDF we should upload (auditor-signed copy in Alfresco under /assurance/2024/SOC2_TypeII_redwood.pdf)
- Any PII redaction needed before sharing? Our standard is none unless requested, but procurement sometimes asks.
- If we issue a bridge letter, legal will sign; ops should confirm the list of controls we can assert in the letter (I recommend KMS rotation cadence, log retention 365 days, IR SLA 24 hours for notification).

Please use the following one-line replies when you push artifacts to the Drive link:
- To Acme (report ready): “Uploaded: SOC 2 Type II PDF and bridge letter template to shared folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE_SHARED_ACME_SOC2 — added audits@acmepayments.com and procurement@acmepayments.com as viewers.”
- To Security (internal): “Actioned: confirmed auditor-signed PDF; no PII redaction required per legal; bridge letter draft being prepared.”

I’ll loop legal if we need signatures on the bridge. Let me know when the folder is ready and I’ll confirm with Acme.

Thanks,
Naomi
Senior Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
